regulations.parking_requirements: At least one off-street parking space per bedroom required
regulations.notes: STRs (vacation rentals) in Durango require a Limited Use Permit (LUP) approved by the Community Development Department before listing or operating. Zone-based caps limit STR density in different areas. STR advertisements must include the permit and business license number. At least one off-street parking space per bedroom is required. Rentals of 30+ days are not considered vacation rentals and have no special requirements.
